fade_in_hero.css: @keyframes fade_in_hero { 0% { opacity: 0; transform: translateY(12px); } 100% { opacity: 1; transform: translateY(0); } } .hero, .hero * { animation: fade_in_hero 2.4s cubic-bezier(0.22, 0.61, 0.36, 1) both; }

extremely_slow_image_crossfade.css: @keyframes crossfade { 0%, 45% { opacity: 1; } 55%, 95% { opacity: 0; } 100% { opacity: 1; } } .crossfade img { animation: crossfade 14s ease-in-out infinite; }

hover_underline_slide.css: .nav-link { position: relative; } .nav-link::after { content: ''; position: absolute; left: 0; bottom: -4px; width: 100%; height: 1px; background: #1A1A1A; transform: scaleX(0); transform-origin: right; transition: transform 1.2s cubic-bezier(0.22, 0.61, 0.36, 1); } .nav-link:hover::after { transform: scaleX(1); transform-origin: left; }

scroll_reveal_product_cards.css: .product-card { opacity: 0; transform: translateY(40px); transition: opacity 1.8s ease, transform 1.8s ease; } .product-card.in-view { opacity: 1; transform: translateY(0); }

nav_reveal.css: .nav-menu { opacity: 0; pointer-events: none; transition: opacity 0.9s ease 0.1s; } .nav-wrapper:hover .nav-menu { opacity: 1; pointer-events: auto; }

home.layout: Full-bleed campaign image with centered wordmark overlay; scroll reveals italic serif collection name, brief editorial paragraph, then a three-column product grid with vast whitespace.

collection.layout: Alternating full-bleed lookbook images and three-column product cards, with minimal text filters in small caps anchored at the top.

product.layout: Two-column split: tall left-side image gallery and a right column with sparse product details, understated price, and a thin 'Reserve' button.

heritage.layout: Long editorial scroll with oversized founding year, long-form prose columns, black-and-white atelier photography, and an embedded craftsmanship film.

contact.layout: Two-column layout pairing a minimal monochrome map and boutique addresses with a formal private-appointment booking form in fine serif type.
